sources.evidence_excerpt: With error configured, one existing and one absent path completed without an error.

intended_control: Upload two declared artifact paths and fail the workflow when a declared output is absent.
false_acceptance: The action succeeded because at least one path matched, leaving the second declared artifact absent without failing the gate.

causal_chain.claim: The workflow declares first_dir and second_dir under one upload step with if-no-files-found set to error.
The reproducer creates only first_dir and reports that no error is emitted for missing second_dir.
The option guards emptiness of the combined match set rather than completeness of each declared path.

steps: Create first_dir/file1.txt in a GitHub Actions job and do not create second_dir.
Invoke actions/upload-artifact@v3.1.3 with both paths and if-no-files-found:error.
reproducer.observed: The upload step emitted no error although second_dir did not exist.
reproducer.expected: The missing declared path should fail the step.

facts: The issue provides a complete minimal workflow and observed behavior.
derivations: The success contract is ambiguous between any-match and every-declared-path semantics.
unknowns: The open issue contains no maintainer ruling that every path was part of the action's promised contract.

counterclassification.label: OUT_OF_SCOPE
counterclassification.would_be_primary_if: The documented contract defines error only when the union of all patterns is empty, making per-path completeness an unsupported expectation.
